posts.author: TsukiStuffs
posts.body:
Hey everybody.
Over the past few months, I have been killing time by creating tilesets for my own future projects. I figured I'd share some with you.
Some textures used are taken from old Japanese texture CDs and online royalty-free texture archives.
Some tiles are heavily edited or traced from the MV and MZ RTP tilesets, and as such you must own both MV and MZ to use these.
Otherwise, everything was drawn in Krita and then indexed in Aseprite using the AAP-Splendor128 palette.
I am in fact taking requests, so don't be shy.
The only rules to using these are that you need to credit TsukiStuffs (that's me), and that you cannot use my material in any project themed around real-world politics and/or societal issues. As previously mentioned, you also must own RPG Maker MV and MZ. Additional required credits will be specified for individual tiles when necessary. Apart from that, anything is fair game.
Ground tiles
Cliffs (note: autotiled cliff has less shading due to autotile limitations)
Trees and nature
(Some of the trees are drawn over/traced from other tree assets I found online. Additional credit required for trees: GalacticGod, engvee, ninjikin)
Skulls and blood stains
Exterior walls (wip) and windows
Chairs and autotile table (includes template to overlay textures on)
Beds
Misc objects as requested by friends (stone goblet, mortar & pestle, barrel, globe, gold statuette, gold chalice)
BONUS: textures used (some custom, others taken from elsewhere (see above). note: palette not indexed)

posts.body: Looks pretty good! Keep up the good work! Interested to see what you will do next.
